PATHOLOGY REPORT
Accession: PATH-2024-99201 | Specimen: CT-guided core biopsy, right lower lobe

CLINICAL HISTORY: 68-year-old male, former smoker (30 pack-years, quit 2015). ECOG 1.

DIAGNOSIS: Poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma, solid growth pattern.
Tumor size: 55 mm on imaging correlation.
Lymphovascular invasion: Present.

MOLECULAR PATHOLOGY (FoundationOne CDx NGS):
KRAS G12C mutation (c.34G>T, p.G12C) — VAF 38%
EGFR: Wild-type
ALK: Negative
ROS1: Negative
TP53: Mutated
STK11: Mutated
PD-L1 IHC (22C3): Tumor Proportion Score 45%
TMB: 8.1 Muts/Mb

---

RADIOLOGY REPORT — CT CHEST
Findings: 5.5 cm mass in the right lower lobe. Station 10R node 1.4 cm — N1 disease.
Pleural invasion suspected. No distant metastases.
Impression: Stage IIIA (T2bN1M0).

---

MEDICAL ONCOLOGY NOTE
68M former smoker. Prior carboplatin/pemetrexed x4 cycles.
Assessment: Stage IIIA LUAD, KRAS G12C, PD-L1 45%.
Plan: Discuss sotorasib vs chemo-IO per guidelines. Tumor board referral.
